verdict.rationale: The evidence shows push approval only as a Twilio Verify channel, and Verify is the designated successor to the deprecated Authy API, not a feature of the Authy app itself. Nothing in the pack documents number matching, location or context display on push prompts, or admin-enforced MFA policies. The only related controls are user-level settings such as disabling new installs, protecting the app with a PIN or TouchID, and removing lost devices, none of which are the phishing defenses the story asks for.
